+def _apply_table(s, table):
+    """
+    Same as doing s = s.replace(ps, c) for every table entry in order, but
+    skips replacements that cannot match: present is a superset of the
+    characters in s (its initial characters plus every token minted by a
+    replacement that changed s), so a pair with a token outside it is absent.
+    """
+    present = set(s)
+    add = present.add
+    for ps, c, a, b in table:
+        if a in present and b in present:
+            n = len(s)
+            s = s.replace(ps, c)
+            if len(s) != n:
+                add(c)
+    return s
